actions.source_action: 起步时先向左侧横移两步，让出石台正前方的通路，长弓保持贴近身体。然后沿浅色石板向前跑到石台左前角，降低身体重心，贴着石台左缘绕行。经过第一根石柱时从柱子内侧侧身穿过，跨过地上的碎石，继续沿长廊方向前进。到第二根石柱前转向右侧，绕过石台后方凸起的地砖，再沿后缘跑向靠近拱门的一端。接近终点时先缩短步幅，右脚稳稳落地，再让左脚跟上，身体逐渐转向庭院中央。最后停在石台后侧与拱门之间的开阔位置，双脚分开，膝盖微弯，左手握弓，右手搭在弓弦上，视线朝向队友，保持与石台边缘一步的距离。
actions.appearance: Adult adventurer, refined light armor, carrying a longbow, agile.
actions.action: <Subject 1> steps left to clear the path, then runs along the light stone slabs to the platform's front-left corner. Lowering their center of gravity, they skirt the left edge, slipping past the first pillar and stepping over gravel. They continue along the corridor, turn right at the second pillar, and run around the platform's rear toward the archway. Slowing down, they plant their right foot, bring the left foot up, and settle into a stable stance with knees bent, bow in hand, facing the courtyard center.
actions.beat: runs along the platform edge and settles into a stable stance
actions.target: the open area between the rear of the stone platform and the archway
actions.path: left, then forward along the platform edge, then around the rear
actions.end_state: standing with knees bent, facing the courtyard center

actions.source_action: 先面对石台沿庭院中央直线向后跑三步，到深浅石板的交界处时朝左转身，沿长廊边缘跑向第一根石柱。右手握着长剑，剑尖始终朝向地面，左臂随着步伐摆动。经过第一根石柱时绕到外侧避开碎石，再从两根石柱之间的空隙穿过，跑到第二根石柱后侧。随后以左脚为支点朝右转半圈，沿第二根石柱的半圆路径减速移动到靠庭院的一面。最后从柱边向前走两步，停在长廊入口右侧的平整石板上，双脚错开站稳，长剑斜向下握在身侧，肩膀放松，上身转向石台与拱门之间的队友，保留身后一小段可以后退的空间。
actions.appearance: Adult adventurer, light leather armor, wearing a longsword at the waist.
actions.action: <Subject 2> runs backward three steps from the platform, turns left at the stone boundary, and sprints along the corridor edge toward the first pillar. Sword tip down, they pass the pillar's outer side, dodge gravel, and weave between the first and second pillars. Pivoting on their left foot, they move along the second pillar's curve, slowing down. They step forward twice onto the flat stone near the corridor entrance, plant their feet, and relax their shoulders, turning their upper body toward the teammates between the platform and archway.
actions.beat: runs along the corridor edge and stops near the entrance
actions.target: the flat stone slab to the right of the corridor entrance
actions.path: backward, then left along the corridor edge, then forward
actions.end_state: standing with sword held low, facing the courtyard center

actions.source_action: 从当前位置朝右前方起跑，沿台阶外缘接近拱门，背上的长弓随身体轻微起伏，双手保持自然摆动。接近第一层台阶时收小步幅，依次踏上三层石阶，先走到拱门左侧，再沿门洞边缘转身朝向庭院。观察队友的位置后，沿拱门旁石柱的内侧绕半圈，跨过门槛旁凸起的石块，再从台阶另一侧依次走下三层石阶。落地时左脚先踏稳，随后向中央石台方向小跑三步，沿一条右弧线避开地上的碎石堆，逐渐减速。最后停在石台右前角与台阶底部之间的浅色石板上，双脚分开，身体面向左侧长廊，右脚略微后撤，头部转向两位队友。
actions.appearance: Adult adventurer, refined light armor, carrying a longbow, skilled at observing paths.
actions.action: <Subject 3> sprints forward-right toward the archway, then steps up the three stone stairs. Reaching the top, they turn left, circle the pillar's inner side, and step over a threshold stone. Descending the stairs on the other side, they land on their left foot and jog three steps toward the central platform. Curving right to avoid a gravel pile, they slow down and stop on the light stone slab between the platform's front-right corner and the stairs. Standing with feet apart, they face the left corridor, stepping the right foot back slightly while turning their head toward the teammates.
actions.beat: descends the stairs and stops near the platform corner
actions.target: the light-colored stone slab between the front-right corner of the stone platform and the bottom of the steps
actions.path: forward-right, up the stairs, around the pillar, down the stairs, then right
actions.end_state: standing with feet apart, facing the left corridor

actions.source_action: 先向左侧横移两步，让出庭院中央的行进路线，随后沿石台近侧边缘朝长廊方向跑去。经过第一个拐角时向右前方转弯，双膝稍微弯曲，绕开一块凸起的石板，右手保持握剑且剑尖朝下。跑到长廊入口时先减速，左脚踏稳后转身朝向庭院中央，一边面朝队友一边向后跑三步，再向右侧横移跨过碎石旁的窄缝。接着沿石台后方的短直线跑向右缘，经过石台右后角时转入台阶前的通路。最后逐步缩短步幅，在石台右缘与台阶之间停稳，双脚分开形成稳定站姿，右手将长剑贴近腿侧，左手抬到胸前，肩膀与视线同时转向中央石台。
actions.appearance: Adult adventurer, light leather armor, wearing a longsword at the waist, skilled at guarding.
actions.action: <Subject 4> steps left to clear the path, then runs along the platform's near edge toward the corridor. Turning right at the corner, they bend their knees to bypass a raised stone slab, sword tip down. Reaching the corridor entrance, they slow down, pivot, and run backward three steps toward the courtyard center. Shifting right over a gravel gap, they sprint along the platform's rear edge to the right side. Turning at the rear corner, they approach the stairs, slowing their steps. They stop between the platform's right edge and the stairs, planting their feet, holding the sword low, and turning their shoulders and gaze toward the central platform.
actions.beat: runs along the platform rear and stops near the stairs
actions.target: between the right edge of the stone platform and the steps
actions.path: left, then forward along the platform edge, then around the rear
actions.end_state: standing with sword low, facing the central platform
